description.value:
Duration constant

You may make ranged Strikes as reactions against enemies entering your reach without expending your reaction, once per enemy per round. Each such Strike costs one loaded round from the weapon it is made with; when nothing you wield is loaded, this stops until you reload.

cinderfall.incomplete: grants a new usable reaction, per's fixed convention. This card's entire effect is a limited-use activated action/reaction that hands the actor a wholly new usable action -- per this pass's fixed bucket-3 convention this is always INCOMPLETE regardless of precedent. Ironsight's own real-world analog, the Gunslinger, ships this exact shape unencoded across dozens of its own Strike-variant/reload-trick/called-shot feats (e.g. pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/feats/class/gunslinger/level-10/called-shot.json, level-6/scatter-blast.json, level-1/dual-weapon-reload.json, all rules: []) -- confirming this is the standard shape for a gunfighter class, not license to SKIP.
